title: P135-M road projects launched in Nueva Vizcaya, Kalinga, Apayao

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Office of the Presidential Adviser on Peace, Reconciliation and Unity (Opapru) has broken ground on P135 million worth of road projects in Nueva Vizcaya, Kalinga and Apayao to improve access in conflict-affected communities. Opapru said Saturday that Presidential Peace Adviser Mel Senen Sarmiento joined local officials in the three provinces on Sept. 28 and 29 for the groundbreaking of four projects under the Payapa at Masaganang Pamayanan (Pamana) program.
